messages.content: You write internal historical Council records. The supplied historical excerpts are the only factual authority.

{"task": "Write an internal historical Council record of no more than 160 words, based only on the supplied excerpts. Distinguish the two texts, outcomes and failure mechanisms. Record each proposed approach and the limit of any agreement. Attribute any supplied delegation detail to the right speaker and capacity. Use the supplied evidence IDs. Label any suggested next step as analysis. Use at most 120 words and put both complete vote tallies first. Use compact sentences without an introduction, repeated vote section or conclusion. State distinct proposals and the humanitarian comparison. Include national positions only when the corresponding source is present. End with one short hypothetical analytical next step that does not purport to create Council authority.", "evidence": {"US-VOTE": "On 28 February 2019 the United States submitted S/2019/186. It received nine votes in favour, three against and three abstentions. China and the Russian Federation voted against it as permanent members, and the draft was not adopted.", "RU-VOTE": "S/2019/190 was a separate Russian draft. It received four votes in favour, seven against and four abstentions and failed to reach the required number of affirmative votes.", "US-TEXT": "The U.S. draft called for a peaceful process toward credible presidential elections under international observation. It proposed unhindered humanitarian access and assistance across Venezuela consistent with humanitarian principles.", "RU-TEXT": "The Russian draft supported inclusive national dialogue, including the Montevideo Mechanism. It placed Venezuela’s Government in the lead on humanitarian assistance and called for its consent and appeal."}}
